sam: saw the alert. can someone grep for quantization/decoder flags in this build?

leah: quick sample diff attached:
```diff
- expected: "The research indicates a sustained uptick in active users, particularly in EMEA and APAC markets."
+ actual:   "Users up. EMEA fine. APAC numbers unclear."
```

pm-rita: surface-impact decision: recommend holding EU rollout and pin region routing to v3.2.1 until triage. Will add note to release notes and notify support.

sam: +1 to pin. also request running eval again with beam=1 and beam=4 to confirm decoder sensitivity.

eval-bot: rerun scheduled: beams=[1,4], stratify by token_count buckets. ETA 8m.

kumar: if this narrows to decoder flag we can flip the flag in a patch build and run a quick canary. owner: eng-runtime + eng-ml pair on bisect.

leah: I've created a small reproducer: attach link -> job#7821. includes failing prompt and minimal context.

sam: operational ask to SRE: can we apply routing pin with instant fallback to primary if capacity > 90%? Need to avoid disrupt.

deploy-bot: route update pending: will apply "region=eu -> model=v3.2.1 (pinned)" on confirmation.

leah: rerun results: beam=1 -> failure 0.2%, beam=4 -> failure 1.1% concentrated in >6k token docs. Strong signal.

pm-rita: decision: pin EU now. PR for release notes w/ customer blurb and internal mitigation created. ETA for eng-ml triage: 3h. If QA signoff not before 15:00Z escalate to rollback. tagging @kumar @sam.

sam: applying pin now. will monitor latency & capacity.

deploy-bot: route update applied: eu -> v3.2.1 (pinned) at 2026-03-21T12:18Z

kumar: assigning bisect: eng-ml: @kumar, eng-runtime: @leah. starting parameterized bisect across decoder flag and quantization kernels.

sam: thanks team. keep updates short here. will unpin only after QA + ML signoff.
